sqliteSearchMeasurement.scope: Synthetic SQLite query microbenchmark; not Minecraft tick latency, JDBC overhead, concurrent writes or production capacity.

coverage: Personal participant filters include sender or recipient; excludes win; command-root filters do not alter saved records.
Status and all-channel off controls; matching-category permission revocation, explicit resubscription, default-off capture and auth exclusions retained.
All three actual vanilla whisper aliases; rejected targets and filtered recipients unchanged.
Private literal search on memory/SQLite/optional DuckDB precedes paging; percent, underscore and SQL-like strings are literal.
Quoted text navigation, malformed/empty filter diagnostics and exact hover details.
Safe labelled Unicode previews with no executable click actions; full console text retained.
Existing per-tick output cap and clearer suppression counts. Query timing contains no message or filter content.
performanceLimits: Rendering measurements run on the server thread with synthetic immutable rows and compare one versus eight formatter invocations, not a full eight-client network/tick benchmark. SQLite measurement excludes JDBC, concurrency, disk-cold and production-pack behavior. No broad TPS claim.
limits: Real-client hover/layout and production-pack acceptance remain pending. No new capture category, recovery target or automatic monitoring; existing durability and per-delivery permissions retained. Text search requires up to 7d and page<=100; this is a time/result bound, not a hard execution deadline. General history filters remain optional.
